label: Reranking
type: a post-search phase that reorders approximate vector results by comparing full (unquantized) vectors
note: Enabled through the fifth parameter of n1ql:approx-vector-distance rather than through a statement of its own, and it requires vector-search:persist-full-vector. Do NOT confuse with the page id vector-index:hyperscale-reranking, which is the title of the how-to page 'Hyperscale Vector Index Reranking and Full Vector Persistence' and denotes a document; that id is retired by this round. Same word, one concept and one page, and the page outranked the concept on every mention count until seeAlso stopped counting as recurrence.
relates_to_competency_question: What can I tune on a vector index, and what does it cost?
